verdict.rationale: AI Gateway is designed to be used via existing official SDKs (OpenAI client libraries, Anthropic SDK, Vercel AI SDK) with just a base URL/model-string change, documented in openai-compat and getting-started guides, and confirmed by a live OpenAI-compatible endpoint probe. It also supports agent-building primitives like ToolLoopAgent for agentic workflows. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer confirmation beyond vendor docs and one API probe.
